$comment: CAPTURED, NOT AUTHORED. A real Claude Code v2.1.220 session (tui: fullscreen, so the alt screen) parsed by @xterm/headless at 120x30, captured with scripts/probe-terminal-peek-grid.js --mode claude. Nothing was edited: Claude Code prints its cwd banner home-relative (the leading ~), so the capture carried no machine-specific path to redact. This is the shape the Agent Monitor's output peek has to survive: the agent's real output sits in the MIDDLE of the grid, while the bottom rows are the input box (row 26 top border, row 27 the cursor's input line, row 28 bottom border) and the mode line (row 29). A naive last-non-empty-lines rule returns rows 27-29, which is pure chrome.
